get.description: Newest first unless `order=asc`. Filters combine with AND. `principal` is a subject such as `user:<uuid>`, `token:<uuid>` or `system:api`; `action` is exact or, when it ends with a dot, a namespace prefix such as `ipam.prefix.`; `object` is a kind such as `prefix`, or `kind:uuid`. Records are read in sequence order and a request examines at most 20,000 of them: when that runs out first, the page holds the matches found so far, possibly none, and `next_cursor` continues the scan. `next_cursor` is null only when the scan reached the end of the log.

get.summary: Verify the hash chain of the audit log
get.description: Walks the whole chain from record 1 and reports the first record that does not verify: a gap in the sequence, a record that does not link to its predecessor, or one whose hash no longer matches its content. `checked` counts the records that did verify, `head` is the last of them and `store_head` the newest record of the log. Reads the whole log; on a long log it takes a while.

200.description: The verification report; `intact` is false when the chain is broken

403.description: Not allowed

parameters.description: Sequence number of the audit record, from 1
